findings.claim: FY2025 僅一家客戶（經銷商）占營收約11%（2024年約10%），橫跨所有報告部門；公司稱不依賴單一客戶。
findings.excerpt: We had one customer, a distributor, whose revenue accounted for approximately 11% and 10% of the total revenue for the years ended 2025 and 2024, respectively, across all reportable segments. Although we are not dependent on any single customer, a significant disruption in key customer relationships could adversely affect our business.

findings.claim: 該經銷商占應收帳款約10%（2025年底），2024年底為13%；2023年無客戶超過10%。經銷商整體占營收54%。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 財報附註
findings.excerpt: One customer, a distributor, accounted for approximately 10% and 13% of the Company's accounts receivable balance as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

note: 搜尋未發現該經銷商信用降級、破產或下修財測的報導；10-K未點名該經銷商。
